title: Teams
coreMove: Diagnose the room by how safely useful signal moves before status fear edits it out.
sourcePressure: The chapter centers on psychological safety: Google data scientists studied teams for four years and found that interaction quality matters more than individual composition; Saturday Night Live supplies a creative-room echo.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing team performance to talent, friendship, or everyone being nice.

sourceAnchors.name: Google four-year team study
sourceAnchors.detail: official copy says Google data scientists ran a four-year study of how the best teams function
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Google spent years looking for the magic in team rosters and found the room itself mattered more than the names on it.

sourceAnchors.name: psychological safety
sourceAnchors.detail: the sidecar permits the exact term and frames it as the chapter mechanism for voice and interaction quality
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Psychological safety is the quiet permission to put an unfinished doubt into the room before the decision hardens.

sourceAnchors.name: Saturday Night Live
sourceAnchors.detail: official copy says the same principle helps explain why Saturday Night Live became a hit
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A comedy room needs rough lines to survive long enough to improve; if every weak draft is punished, the room edits too soon.

hook: Person at a meeting realizes the real lesson
The day starts with a dashboard
counterintuition: Productivity is not doing more faster
The problem is not effort but something deeper

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

exampleSpecs.domain: a municipal flood-response briefing before sandbag crews are deployed
exampleSpecs.audience: an emergency planner leading police, works crews, and volunteers
exampleSpecs.stakes: one quiet hydrology warning could change where crews go first
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Claire stops the senior officer from closing the briefing and asks the junior hydrologist to name the one assumption that feels unsafe
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Before we lock this route, who sees the weak spot?" Claire says

exampleSpecs.domain: a touring theater company deciding whether to cut a scene after previews
exampleSpecs.audience: a stage manager watching actors hide doubts around the director
exampleSpecs.stakes: a weak second act will stay broken if no one risks naming it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lukas opens notes by sharing one staging mistake he made, then asks each actor for one line that is not landing
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The rehearsal room smells of dust, sweat, and wet wool coats

exampleSpecs.domain: a London hospital ward handoff where nurses soften bad news for a famous surgeon
exampleSpecs.audience: a senior registrar trying to catch medication-risk signals
exampleSpecs.stakes: a dosage change may be missed if the room protects rank
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: At 6:42 a.m., Hadiya asks the nurse who hesitated to repeat the concern exactly, while the consultant is still present
exampleSpecs.firstImage: At 6:42 a.m., Hadiya sees one nurse touch the medication sheet and pull her hand back

exampleSpecs.domain: a junior cycling team reviewing a near-crash before race day
exampleSpecs.audience: a coach with riders who are scared to blame a popular captain
exampleSpecs.stakes: a repeat mistake could put two riders on the pavement
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Jack until the video replay to see that riders described the crash differently when the captain left the room
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Jack three replays to notice who stopped talking when the captain leaned forward
mustAvoid: repeated bike helmet prop as central anchor

exampleSpecs.domain: a newsroom morning pitch meeting after a correction went public
exampleSpecs.audience: a deputy editor trying to restore early error reporting
exampleSpecs.stakes: another thinly checked story could damage trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ingrid compares the old pitch order with a new first round where reporters must name one uncertainty before selling the story
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Two corrected headlines sit taped to the glass wall

exampleSpecs.domain: a family-owned furniture workshop choosing whether to accept a rush hotel order
exampleSpecs.audience: a second-generation operations lead balancing family status and production truth
exampleSpecs.stakes: the order could save the month or break the shop schedule
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Pablo has everyone write the riskiest constraint before his father gives an opinion, then compares the cards after the room talks
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Which warning disappears when the founder speaks first?
mustAvoid: letting the question hook replace the visible action beat

skillTargets: identify when silence is self-protection rather than agreement
choose meeting moves that lower the cost of candor
separate psychological safety from comfort or niceness

tryThisNowSpec: In the next group conversation, ask the quietest informed person what risk they see before you state your own preference.
